anna-rep: Thinking: one-off token credit + suspend min-charge for first billing month. Also soft daily cap per key so we avoid runaway.

mike-billing: Finance ok for one-off credit under $2k but need PO and credit memo. Also require MOU language.

chris-evans: Suggest: 300k-token credit, waive month-1 min, soft cap 150k/day per key, burst to 450k/day consuming credit. Overage billed normally.

infra-bot: Quota rule template: quota.soft_cap=150000; quota.burst=450000; credit.tokens=300000; alerts=[#sales,@chris-evans] at 80%;

tara-legal: I'll draft a brief MOU clause: "Pilot credit is a one-time concession, non-recurring, applies only to pilot usage." Need account id and dates.

mike-billing: Creating credit memo now. Please provide PO before applying.

chris-evans: Thanks. I'll get PO and post back.

anna-rep: Filing to deal desk with the snippet above.
